source: docs/product/ai-layer-2026-10.md section 5 (values copied verbatim); Free weekly portions and calendar zone: owner decisions 2026-10-02.

calendar.note: Owner decision 2026-10-02. Every day, week (Monday 00:00) and month boundary of every window is a calendar boundary in this zone, kept as a single policy key. Europe/Moscow has no daylight saving, so a boundary is a fixed UTC offset (+03:00).

periodRules.paidBar: The whole monthly bar is available at once. The daily burst limits the DEBITS of one calendar day to maxFraction of the bar; admission checks the monthly availability only, a step whose debit would exceed the burst waits (READY with next_attempt_at at the next day start), a running step completes.
periodRules.freeBar: Weekly portions that accumulate within the month (credits.schedule WEEKLY_PORTIONS); nothing carries over to the next month.
periodRules.boost: A +50% boost is planned after recurring payments exist; it is not part of v1.

fairUseMetering.stt: Metered in seconds; shown as whole minutes rounded up. A plan with unlimited STT has limit null and a velocityPerDay limit.

guarantee: The sum of all caps stays at most 25% of the price after income tax (NPD 4%) and acquiring (about 3%). After two cohorts the bar is re-based on measured p95 (x1.35-1.5).

creditSchedule.note: Owner decision 2026-10-02. The portions sum to the 50 bar. The first unlocks on the 1st of the period, the next on each following Monday 00:00 in the calendar zone until the bar is fully unlocked; a month with a fifth Monday gets no extra. Unlocked but unspent credits stay usable until the period ends.

MAX.featureToggle: Shown as 'in progress' with teasers behind a feature toggle until TTS and images are ready

notes: Plan identifiers are stable wire values: FREE, PLUS, PRO, MAX.

caps.qualityImages is a count of quality generated images per month: 0 on FREE and PLUS (generation arrives later), 10 on PRO, 25 on MAX. `images` states what the plan offers; image generation itself is availability LATER in the rate card.
caps.podcasts and caps.highFactcheck are counts per month; a cap of 0 means the operation is not offered on the plan (problem member offered=false).
MAX speech-to-text has no monthly limit (minutesPerMonth null) and a velocity limit of 120 minutes per day.
